panel_a_left.n_definition: All valid ubiquitin residues, including three valid zero-reference Pro positions.
panel_a_left.MAE: mean absolute error of frozen joint-Hchi prediction vs original five-window mean reference, nats.

panel_a_right.source: experiment/per_chi_correlations.csv; predictor=predicted_joint_Hchi; metric=fine_entropy or low_Fstar_width; field=rho_AA_centered
panel_a_right.model_output: One joint-Hchi value per residue from frozen full-model test fold 0. No single-angle model entropy or width predictions exist.
panel_a_right.MD_entropy: Natural-log Shannon entropy in 5-degree angle bins, mean of four origins 0,1.25,2.5,3.75 degrees, per chi.
panel_a_right.MD_width: Sum of all 5-degree bins with Fstar<=1, mean of the same four origins; degrees.
panel_a_right.AA_control: Within each chi layer, separately subtract same-amino-acid mean from model joint Hchi and MD metric; compute Spearman of all paired residuals. Singleton amino-acid types and constant groups remain zero residuals/ties; average ranks retained.
panel_a_right.missing: 113 undefined slots retained in source table; not zero-imputed into correlations.
panel_a_right.intervals_tests: No intervals, p-values, or new statistical tests; no independent MD repeats implied.
panel_a_right.model_selection: No new training, seed choice or site selection.

panels_b_d.n: two residues x three angles x 72 five-degree bins
panels_b_d.selection: Q41/Q2 frozen-model minimum/maximum among all six GLN.
panels_b_d.definition: MD Fstar=-ln(p/pmax), origin 0 degrees; zero-count bins remain NaN and disconnected.
panels_b_d.time_scope: same501 frames as a-right, but b-d displays origin0 rather than four-origin average.
